Hair Clinic

Diagnosis first, treatment second.

Hair loss and scalp concerns rarely have a single cause. Our trichology-led approach starts with a proper diagnosis — examining scalp health, hair growth cycles and underlying factors — before recommending any treatment.

Whether you're dealing with thinning hair, dandruff, or early signs of hair loss, we build a plan around your specific case rather than a one-size-fits-all routine.
